_meta.name: Onboarding and due diligence checklist templates
_meta.status: Generated per customer from the effective risk tier and risk tags. Every quote is verbatim from docs/data/laws/32024R1624_EN.json (AMLR) or from EBA/GL/2024/01 and was checked programmatically; the task wording is RegRadar's own summary. Items marked 'Good practice' cite no obligation.
_meta.tiers_note: tiers: which effective tiers show the item. anyTag: item shows if the customer has at least one of these tags. notTag: item is hidden if the customer has any of these tags.

items.task: Identify the customer and verify identity
items.quote: identifying the customer and verifying the customer’s identity;

items.task: Collect the minimum identification data set
items.quote: shall obtain at least the following information in order to identify the customer

items.task: Verify identity before the relationship starts (or document why the derogation applies)
items.quote: shall take place before the establishment of a business relationship or the carrying out of an occasional transaction

items.task: Identify the beneficial owners, verify them, and understand the ownership and control structure
items.quote: it understands the ownership and control structure of the customer

items.task: Collect proof of registration or a recent register excerpt
items.quote: collect valid proof of registration or a recently issued excerpt of the register confirming validity of registration

items.task: Report any discrepancy with the beneficial ownership register (14 calendar days)
items.quote: report to the central registers any discrepancies they find

items.task: Verify the authority of anyone acting for the customer and identify them
items.quote: verifying that any person purporting to act on behalf of the customer is so authorised

items.task: Record the purpose, expected amount, source and destination of funds, and the business or occupation
items.quote: assure itself that it understands its purpose and intended nature

items.task: Understand the nature of the customer's business or employment
items.quote: assessing and, as appropriate, obtaining information on the nature of the customers’ business

items.task: Screen the customer, beneficial owners and controlling persons for targeted financial sanctions
items.quote: verifying whether the customer or the beneficial owners are subject to targeted financial sanctions

items.task: Determine whether the customer or a beneficial owner is a PEP, family member or close associate
items.quote: is a politically exposed person, a family member or person known to be a close associate

items.task: Obtain trustee and arrangement details for the trust or similar arrangement
items.quote: basic information on the legal arrangement

items.task: Record nominee shareholders or directors and their nominee status
items.quote: the names of persons holding shares or a directorship position in nominee form, including reference to their status as nominee shareholders or directors

items.task: Record that no beneficial owner could be identified and verify the senior managing officials
items.quote: identify all the natural persons holding the positions of senior managing officials in the legal entity and shall verify their identity

items.task: Keep this risk assessment on file so you can demonstrate the measures fit the risk
items.quote: at all times be able to demonstrate to their supervisors that the measures taken are appropriate in view of the risks

items.task: Record the CDD actions, decisions, supporting documents and justifications
items.quote: shall keep record of the actions taken in order to comply with the requirement to apply customer due diligence measures

items.task: Set ongoing monitoring and the next review date (shown in this file)
items.quote: The period between updates of customer information pursuant to the first subparagraph shall be dependent on the risk posed by the business relationship

items.task: If you reduce measures, document the lower-risk factors you relied on
items.quote: Obliged entities shall document decisions to take into account additional factors of lower risk.

items.task: Confirm no exclusion applies (doubts about the information, suspicion, sanctions evasion)
items.quote: shall refrain from applying simplified due diligence measures in any of the following situations

items.task: Obtain additional information on the customer and the beneficial owners
items.quote: obtaining additional information on the customer and the beneficial owners;

items.task: Obtain additional information on the intended nature of the relationship
items.quote: obtaining additional information on the intended nature of the business relationship;

items.task: Obtain and verify the source of funds and source of wealth
items.quote: obtaining additional information on the source of funds, and source of wealth of the customer and of the beneficial owners;

items.task: Obtain the reasons for intended or performed transactions and check they fit the relationship
items.quote: obtaining information on the reasons for the intended or performed transactions and their consistency with the business relationship;

items.task: Obtain senior management approval to establish or continue the relationship
items.quote: obtaining the approval of senior management for establishing or continuing the business relationship;

items.task: Set up enhanced monitoring: more controls, better timed, patterns selected for scrutiny
items.quote: conducting enhanced monitoring of the business relationship by increasing the number and timing of controls applied

items.task: Consider requiring the first payment from the customer's own account at a credit institution
items.quote: requiring the first payment to be carried out through an account in the customer’s name with a credit institution

items.task: Examine origin, destination and purpose of complex, unusually large or unexplained transactions
items.quote: shall examine the origin and destination of funds involved in, and the purpose of, all transactions

items.task: Review and update customer information at least every 12 months
items.quote: for higher risk customers to which measures under Section 4 of this Chapter apply, 1 year;

items.task: Apply the Art. 34(4) enhanced measures: the customer or owner is linked to an EU high-risk third country
items.quote: obliged entities shall apply enhanced due diligence measures listed in Article 34(4) with respect to the business relationships or occasional transactions involving natural or legal persons from that third country

items.task: Apply the country-specific countermeasures set in the Commission delegated act
items.quote: shall identify among the countermeasures listed in Article 35 the specific countermeasures mitigating specific risks stemming from each high-risk third country

items.task: Obtain senior management approval for the PEP relationship
items.quote: obtain senior management approval for carrying out occasional transactions or for establishing or continuing business relationships with politically exposed persons

items.task: Establish the source of wealth and source of funds
items.quote: take adequate measures to establish the source of wealth and source of funds

items.task: Apply enhanced, ongoing monitoring
items.quote: conduct enhanced, ongoing monitoring of those business relationships

items.task: Family members and close associates: confirm the same measures are applied
items.quote: shall also apply to family members or persons known to be close associates of politically exposed persons

items.task: Former PEP: keep mitigating measures for at least 12 months after leaving office
items.quote: but in any case for not less than 12 months following the time when the individual ceased to be entrusted with a prominent public function

items.task: Apply at least Art. 34(4) measures (a), (c), (e) and (f)
items.quote: shall, as a minimum, apply enhanced due diligence measures set out in Article 34(4), points (a), (c), (e) and (f)

items.task: Assess the risk of transfers to or from self-hosted addresses and apply mitigating measures
items.quote: shall identify and assess the risk of money laundering and financing of terrorism associated with transfers of crypto-assets directed to or originating from a self-hosted address

items.task: Obtain confirmation that a self-hosted address sending funds is controlled by the customer
items.quote: Obtain confirmation that a self-hosted address, from which a transfer is received, is under the control or ownership of the CASP’s customer.

items.task: Verify identity using more than one reliable and independent source
items.quote: Verify the customer’s and the beneficial owner’s identity on the basis of more than one reliable and independent source.

items.task: Obtain evidence of the source of funds, wealth or crypto-assets for higher-risk transactions
items.quote: Obtain evidence about the source of funds, the source of wealth or the source of crypto-assets in respect of those transactions that present a higher risk.

items.task: Apply advanced analytics tools to this customer's transactions, especially self-hosted transfers
items.quote: CASPs should apply advanced analytics tools to transactions on a risk-sensitive basis, as a supplement to the standard transaction monitoring tools.

items.task: Resolve the potential sanctions match and record the conclusion before onboarding
items.quote: verifying whether the customer or the beneficial owners are subject to targeted financial sanctions

items.task: Review the adverse media, record the conclusion and any effect on risk
Prior suspicion on file: consult the MLRO and keep this file restricted. Never tell the customer
items.quote: shall not disclose to the customer concerned or to other third persons

items.task: Do not establish the relationship or carry out the transaction
items.quote: it shall refrain from carrying out a transaction or establishing a business relationship

items.task: Consider a suspicious transaction report to the FIU
items.quote: consider reporting a suspicious transaction to the FIU in relation to the customer in accordance with Article 69

items.task: Record the refusal and the reasons
items.quote: shall also apply to situations where obliged entities refuse to enter into a business relationship

items.task: Do not tell the customer that a report is being considered or made
items.quote: shall not disclose to the customer concerned or to other third persons

items.task: Escalate to the MLRO or sanctions officer and log the decision here
